title: M02 W37 four-shot subject-scale bridge pilot v3
reason_for_revision: User identified the composition problem: the S02-to-S03 same-scale change reads as an effective outfit reveal, while S01-to-S02 and S03-to-S04 jump between full and medium person sizes and feel uncomfortable.

sequence.known_defect_outside_selection: blue shirt slips off shoulder after about 3.47s in source

scale_bridge.S01_end: last 0.65s: centered-top digital crop increases smoothly from 1.00x to 1.45x before S02 medium shot
scale_bridge.S02_to_S03: same-scale direct cut with outfit change; no image transition
scale_bridge.S04_start: first 0.65s: centered-top digital crop decreases smoothly from 1.45x to 1.00x after S03 medium shot
scale_bridge.limitation: At 1.45x the 720x1280 source is cropped to about 497x883 pixels before upscaling. This is a technical camera-language test; a formal production version should plan matching camera scale in the source shot to avoid softness.

output.format: WebM MediaRecorder browser canvas technical review output; cue-based seeking is unreliable

edit_method: Same four Grok source clips and v2 timing at normal speed. Next muted source preplays for 0.35s. Only the S01 tail and S04 head receive smooth in-shot digital reframing; no dissolve, wipe, speed change, music or caption.

review.observed: The first scale jump is preceded by a move toward medium framing; the final scale change starts at medium framing and reveals the full outfit. S02-to-S03 remains the same-scale outfit cut. No black interruption or cut-off face was visible in the reviewed samples.
review.limits: Sampled playback and one full browser replay do not establish every-frame identity/wardrobe QA or user editorial approval. Enlarged segments may appear softer. Silent caption-free technical preview only, not publication master.
